name: TetraMin Tropical Flakes
description: The classic staple tropical flake. Manufacturer guaranteed-analysis crude protein minimum is 46%. wasteFactor (0.4) is a MODELLED hobby-consensus coefficient, not a product spec — light flakes drift into the substrate and decay, so flakes carry the highest default waste of the four forms.
notes: Surface + midwater feeders. Feed only what's eaten in a few minutes — uneaten flakes are the classic ammonia source in a new tank.
